objective: Classify website needs and prepare a Nuxt marketing website for Philo production review, or a business-site requirements handoff if persistent business data is needed.
includedScope: Discover the business, audience, brand, and website behaviours.
For marketing, agree brand and sitemap, build and review a Nuxt site, and deliver source and verification evidence.
For business or mixed sites, document data, users, workflows, and architecture questions for Philo; application implementation requires a revised issued brief.
excludedScope: Live deployment or changes to production services.
Business backend, database, authentication implementation, or paid-service provisioning without Philo scope and architecture approval.
completionCriteria: Customer confirms the website classification and requirements.
The deliverables for the selected path are approved and accessible to Philo, with outstanding work and launch dependencies explicit.
A business-site plan is labelled as a planning handoff, not a built application.

items.prompt: Confirm site purpose, visitor actions, marketing/business/mixed classification, and reasons.
For marketing, approve the brand guideline, sitemap, content, and integrations. For business/mixed, confirm journeys, data model, role matrix, and Philo architecture questions.

For marketing, deliver reviewed Nuxt source, assets, observed quality checks, and launch checklist. For business/mixed, deliver the requirements/architecture handoff and explicitly list unimplemented work; no business build is commissioned by this brief.
